findings.reason: PAGE descriptor asks actual declared HTML label text, not for/id accessibility or same-form association. An unresolved control ID does not erase an actual page label. Complete page labels contradict a model missing-label change, so unknown/source_disagrees_with_change is intentionally correct. The suggested filtering PAGE by control association would invent a new requirement. Added direct valid-positive and conflicting-negative counterexamples; FORM unresolved owner remains unknown.

independentAcceptedCorrection.issue: Foreign text nested inside an actual HTML label was silently omitted by the old citation parser, allowing an incomplete label string to look complete or whole-source absence to be asserted.
independentAcceptedCorrection.fix: Bounded foreign subtree text detection makes the finite label witness unresolved whenever nonempty foreign text would be subtracted. Textless decorative SVG remains ignorable. Both positive and negative paths fail closed; no automatic failure/pass.
